      "source": [
        "# 3) Función de inferencia + prueba con una imagen de demostración\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "from PIL import Image\n",
        "from IPython.display import display\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def ask_vlm(image, question, max_new_tokens=200):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Ejecuta SmolVLM sobre una imagen (PIL) con un prompt de texto y devuelve la respuesta.\"\"\"\n",
        "    messages = [\n",
        "        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": [\n",
        "            {\"type\": \"image\"},\n",
        "            {\"type\": \"text\", \"text\": question},\n",
        "        ]}\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "    prompt = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, add_generation_prompt=True)\n",
        "    inputs = processor(text=prompt, images=[image], return_tensors=\"pt\").to(DEVICE)\n",
        "\n",
        "    generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=False)\n",
        "    # Recortamos los tokens del prompt para quedarnos solo con la respuesta\n",
        "    trimmed = generated_ids[:, inputs[\"input_ids\"].shape[1]:]\n",
        "    return processor.batch_decode(trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True)[0].strip()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Imagen de demostración\n",
        "img_url = \"https://github.com/bebechien/gemma/blob/main/PaliGemma_Demo.JPG?raw=true\"\n",
        "input_image = Image.open(requests.get(img_url, stream=True).raw).convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "display(input_image)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Descripción (captioning) de la imagen\n",
        "caption = ask_vlm(input_image, \"Describe esta imagen en detalle.\")\n",
        "print(\"Descripción:\", caption)"
      ]

      "source": [
        "# @title Captura desde webcam con múltiples prompts { display-mode: \"form\" }\n",
        "# La captura por webcam usa la API de Google Colab (no requiere accesos extra).\n",
        "# Reutiliza la función ask_vlm() definida en la celda anterior.\n",
        "from IPython.display import display, Javascript\n",
        "from google.colab.output import eval_js\n",
        "from base64 import b64decode\n",
        "import io\n",
        "import PIL\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def take_photo(quality=0.8):\n",
        "    js = Javascript('''\n",
        "        async function takePhoto(quality) {\n",
        "            const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
        "            const capture = document.createElement('button');\n",
        "            capture.textContent = 'Capturar';\n",
        "            div.appendChild(capture);\n",
        "\n",
        "            const video = document.createElement('video');\n",
        "            video.style.display = 'block';\n",
        "            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video: true});\n",
        "\n",
        "            document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
        "            div.appendChild(video);\n",
        "            video.srcObject = stream;\n",
        "            await video.play();\n",
        "\n",
        "            google.colab.output.setIframeHeight(document.documentElement.scrollHeight, true);\n",
        "            await new Promise((resolve) => capture.onclick = resolve);\n",
        "\n",
        "            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n",
        "            canvas.width = video.videoWidth;\n",
        "            canvas.height = video.videoHeight;\n",
        "            canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0);\n",
        "            stream.getVideoTracks()[0].stop();\n",
        "            div.remove();\n",
        "            return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);\n",
        "        }\n",
        "        ''')\n",
        "    display(js)\n",
        "    data = eval_js('takePhoto({})'.format(quality))\n",
        "    binary = b64decode(data.split(',')[1])\n",
        "    return PIL.Image.open(io.BytesIO(binary)).convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def predict_webcam():\n",
        "    # (título a mostrar, prompt enviado al modelo)\n",
        "    prompts = [\n",
        "        (\"Descripción general\", \"Describe this image.\"),\n",
        "        (\"Prenda principal\", \"What is the main piece of clothing in this image?\"),\n",
        "        (\"Categoría de prenda\",\n",
        "         \"What is the main clothing item? Answer with only one word from these options: \"\n",
        "         \"T-shirt, Trouser, Pullover, Dress, Coat, Sandal, Shirt, Sneaker, Bag, Ankle_boot.\"),\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "\n",
        "    while True:\n",
        "        print(\"\\nCapturando imagen desde la webcam...\")\n",
        "        try:\n",
        "            input_image = take_photo()\n",
        "\n",
        "            # Figura 2x2: original + 3 resultados\n",
        "            plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))\n",
        "            plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)\n",
        "            plt.imshow(input_image)\n",
        "            plt.title(\"Imagen original\")\n",
        "            plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "            for idx, (titulo, prompt) in enumerate(prompts, start=2):\n",
        "                answer = ask_vlm(input_image, prompt)\n",
        "                plt.subplot(2, 2, idx)\n",
        "                plt.imshow(input_image)\n",
        "                plt.title(f\"{titulo}:\\n{answer}\")\n",
        "                plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "                print(f\"\\n{titulo}: {answer}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "            plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "            plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "            user_input = input(\"\\n¿Tomar otra foto? (s/n): \")\n",
        "            if user_input.lower() != \"s\":\n",
        "                break\n",
        "        except Exception as e:\n",
        "            print(f\"Error: {str(e)}\")\n",
        "            break\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ejecuta el bucle de inferencia por webcam\n",
        "predict_webcam()"
      ]
    }
